children.value: > Fact From Story: Navigating external and domestic economic headwinds will not be an easy feat for the administration, but the private sector will be an important catalyst for sustainable development.

> > Fact From Story: With the private sector sharing industry knowledge, resources and potentially even leading certain socio-economic programs and projects of the National Government, it is to be hoped that AmBisyon Natin 2040 of long and healthy lives for Filipinos that are strongly rooted, comfortable, and secure will be achieved.

> > > Fact From Story: The government envisions that by 2028: (1) Climate and disaster risk resilience of communities and institutions will increase (2) Ecosystem resilience will be enhanced, and (3) A low-carbon economy transition is enabled.
> > > Fact From Story: The government calls for embedding resilience, sustainability, and nature-based solutions in infrastructure planning and investment to enhance climate resilience.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Sustainable development involves ensuring resilience, sustainability, and a transition to a low-carbon economy.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Sharing knowledge and resources helps to make sustainable development easier.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Sustainable development requires catalysts to help it progress.
